verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML/compliance platform, and a buyer comparing onboarding and verification vendors could reasonably ask about document capture, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only API-based sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, case management, webhooks and monitoring. There is no mention of native iOS, Android or web SDKs, camera capture, or glare, blur and edge-detection coaching.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try
